title: Replace fabricated IPv6 pubkey derivation vectors with an independent oracle
description: P1 vector correctness/security: test/vectors/ipv6-addresses.json labels arbitrary pubkeys but records IID/native addresses that are not SHA-512(pubkey) derivations (for example all-zero pubkey claims all-zero IID). It also cites production Python as its oracle and has no deterministic generator/consumer. Replace the key-derived cases with an independent hashlib-based exact generator, retain EUI/short forms only as explicitly non-identity link interoperability vectors, add Python consumer checks, and ensure the canonical API exposes no ULA identity path.
close_reason: Verified at HEAD: (1) test/vectors/generate_ipv6_addresses.py rewritten as independent hashlib-based generator ('without importing LICHEN'), derivation h=SHA-512(pubkey); iid=h[0:8] U/L cleared; native=0x02||h[0:7]||iid - hand-verified all_zero_pubkey matches (iid 5046adc1dba83886 = sha512(zero)[0:8] masked), native packing exact. (2) EUI/short forms retained with profile=link_interoperability_only. (3) Python consumers pass: test_key_address_cross_impl_vectors.py + test_link_local_assignment.py = 34 passed. (4) No ULA identity path: addr.py states 'LICHEN does not advertise ULA', native_address_from_pubkey is the sole identity constructor with native-prefix guard; rust identity.rs uses canonical n(pubkey) U/L-cleared derivation. No changes needed.
